        Parameters
        ----------
        servers: List[RemoteAnonServer]

        user_name: str

        self.user_token = user_token

        else:

        if servers:
            self.active_server = servers[0]
        else:
            self.active_server = None
        self.validate_ssl = validate_ssl

            "user_token": self.user_token,
